sections.heading: Oracle Siebel CRM ROI gate for evaluators
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Worth the seat spend if contact management + lead management are weekly must-haves. Counter-signal: Not worth it if Legacy enterprise platform — high TCO and specialization collide with your constraints.

Capability hinge for this product: contact management; lead management; pipeline management; deal management.

Integrations in research: confirm on the product hub.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Enterprise.

sections.heading: Who Oracle Siebel CRM is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Siebel only for continuity of existing Siebel estates — not typical new SMB CRM buys..

Avoid if: Compare Oracle CX, Salesforce, or Dynamics 365 for greenfield enterprise CRM..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Oracle CX on the same job-to-be-done.
